## BStreamingGameSound  
  
The [`BStreamingGameSound`](BStreamingGameSound.md "BStreamingGameSound") class provides the ability to stream audio data. A hook function is called whenever a buffer needs to be filled with audio data. This hook function is set by calling [`SetStreamHook()`](BStreamingGameSound.md#BStreamingGameSound_SetStreamHook "SetStreamHook\(\)").

Using this class requires special magic powers; unless you're directly in contact with Be about it, don't use it. You'll regret it later.
